metadata.chunk_title: How to meet ASU course competency requirements + English competency requirement

facts.value: All new students will be placed in First-Year Composition ENG 101. Students whose native language is not English will be enrolled in ENG 107. Enrollment in ENG 105, Advanced First Year composition, is based on placement test scores.

metadata.chunk_title: English composition placement + Mathematics competency requirement

facts.value: https://english.asu.edu/admission/first-year-composition-courses/faqs#placement

metadata.chunk_title: English composition placement + Mathematics competency requirement

facts.value: If you have college-level transfer credit or test credit equivalent to ASU’s first year composition course(s), that credit will be considered in placement. You can search ASU’s equivalency database for transfer credit.

metadata.chunk_title: English composition placement + Mathematics competency requirement

facts.value: Four years of high school courses: one year each of algebra I, geometry, algebra II and an advanced math class for which algebra II is a prerequisite.

metadata.chunk_title: English composition placement + Mathematics competency requirement

facts.value: Minimum test score of 24 on ACT math, or 580 on SAT math.

metadata.chunk_title: English composition placement + Mathematics competency requirement

facts.value: One transferable 3-credit college math course for which at least intermediate algebra is a prerequisite.

metadata.chunk_title: English composition placement + Mathematics competency requirement

facts.value: Students may meet any one or a combination of the following options, provided that three distinct laboratory-based science courses are completed with a 2.00 unweighted GPA or higher.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Three years of high school laboratory sciences in three different subject areas, preferably biology, chemistry, earth science or physics.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: A laboratory-based integrated science course may be allowed to substitute for one of the three lab sciences.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: A laboratory-based advanced science course may be allowed to substitute for one of the three lab sciences. An advanced science class is a lab science that is generally taken in the last two years of high school and is at least one of the following: an advanced placement course, a higher-level international baccalaureate course, a dual enrollment course, other honors course for which the previous lab science course is a prerequisite.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Minimum test scores in three standardized tests from three different subject matters. The following tests may be taken: SAT II subject test score in chemistry-600, biology-590, physics-620 or ACT test score in science-20.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: Three transferable 4-credit college laboratory science courses from the following: biology, chemistry, earth science or physics. An integrated laboratory science or advanced-level laboratory-based science may be substituted for one of these laboratory subjects.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory science competency requirement

facts.value: ASU requires students to complete three different lab sciences.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: To determine if your lab sciences meet the requirement, ASU may need additional information.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: If additional information is required, a Priority Task called Course Description will be displayed on My ASU.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: High school can submit lab sciences to the courseapproval.asu.edu website for ASU review.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: Submit a course description form for each lab science taken in an accredited online high school environment to ASU’s homeschool representative if not already approved.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: Meet one of the following: Two years of the same high school second language.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: Attainment of a minimum score on a national standardized second language test or placement into a third semester college second language class based on university placement exam results.

metadata.chunk_title: Laboratory Science Courses (for online high schools only) + Second language competency requirement

facts.value: Two transferable 3- or 4-credit, college-level courses in the same second language.
